title: Generation of SARS-COV-2 RNA Transcript Standards for qRT-PCR Detection Assays
author: Chantal Vogels

steps.title: Isolate viral RNA
steps.instruction: Extract viral RNA using an Omega Viral DNA/RNA kit, Trizol, or an equivalent method.

steps.title: Store RNA samples
steps.instruction: Store isolated RNA at 4 °C for same‑day use or at –20 °C for up to one week until PCR.

steps.title: Prepare primers at 10 µM
steps.instruction: Dilute all required primers to a final concentration of 10 µM. Transcripts: N (US CDC‑N1, N2, N3, HKU‑N, China CDC‑N), E (Berlin‑E), nsp14 (HKU‑ORF1), RdRp (Berlin RdRp, low sensitivity), nsp10 (China CDC‑ORF1). See referenced primer sequences.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample, assemble a PCR reaction using Q5 High‑Fidelity 2X Master Mix (NEB Catalog #M0492S) according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Run PCR thermocycling
steps.instruction: Place the PCR tubes in a thermocycler and run the prescribed cycling program (details not provided in the source).

steps.title: Equilibrate magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Allow Mag‑Bind TotalPure NGS beads (Omega Biotek Catalog #M1378‑01) to reach room temperature, then vortex until homogeneous.

steps.title: Adjust PCR product volume
steps.instruction: Bring each PCR product up to a total volume of 25 µL with nuclease‑free water if it is not already at that volume.

steps.title: Bead‑based PCR cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify PCR products using Mag‑Bind beads with the following sequence of actions.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL of equilibrated beads to 25 µL of PCR product, mix well, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min.
Place tubes on a magnetic stand and wait until the solution becomes clear.
While on the magnet, add 200 µL of 80 % ethanol, incubate 30 s, then discard the ethanol.
Repeat the 80 % ethanol wash and remove as much ethanol as possible.
Leave tubes on the magnet and air‑dry for 5 min.
Remove tubes from the magnet, add 20 µL nuclease‑free water, and mix by pipetting.
Return tubes to the magnetic stand, wait until clear, then transfer the supernatant (purified DNA) to a new tube without disturbing the beads.
Optional: If a KingFisher extractor is available, use the automated ‘purification.bdz’ protocol (see https://github.com/grubaughlab/Kingfisher_protocols).

steps.title: Assess DNA fragment size
steps.instruction: Analyze the purified DNA fragments with an Agilent BioAnalyzer using the DNA 1000 kit (High Sensitivity DNA Kit, Catalog #5067‑4626) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Prepare ribonucleotide mix
steps.instruction: Mix equal volumes (2 µL each) of the four ribonucleotide solutions, then add 8 µL of this mixture to each transcription reaction.

steps.title: Add transcription control plasmid
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of pTRI‑Xef plasmid to each reaction; this serves as a transcription control and yields a 1.89 kb transcript.

steps.title: Mix transcription reaction
steps.instruction: Pipette the reaction mixture up and down to mix, then briefly micro‑centrifuge to collect the liquid at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Incubate transcription
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 4 hours.

steps.title: Digest DNA template
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL TURBO DNase to the reaction, mix well, and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add purification components
steps.instruction: Add the specified purification components (as listed in the original protocol) to a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Mix the tube and chill at –20 °C for more than 30 minutes.

steps.title: Pellet RNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, maximum speed, for 15 minutes to pellet the RNA.

steps.title: Wash RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant, wash the pellet with 1 mL of 70 % ethanol, then re‑centrifuge at 4 °C, maximum speed, for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Remove the ethanol completely and resuspend the RNA pellet in 20 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Assess RNA fragment size
steps.instruction: Examine RNA fragment distribution using an Agilent BioAnalyzer with the RNA 6000 Pico kit (or Nano kit), Catalog #5067, following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Calculate RNA copy number
steps.instruction: Use the provided RNA copy‑number calculator to determine genome equivalents per µL and prepare the final RNA standards.
